description: Car Parking Tickets is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by East Cambridgeshire District Council. This dataset is a Car Parking Ticket report, this shows how many tickets were issued, how many have been paid and what course of action has been undertaken in relation to the tickets. This is broken down by each calendar month and provides a total for the financial year. Coverage: East Cambridgeshire District Council. The portal files it under the publisher East Cambridgeshire District Council. The portal shows 2026-07-08 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is UK Open Government Licence (OGL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
